title: Smallest Missing Genetic Value in Each Subtree
goal: Find the smallest missing positive genetic value in every subtree.
strategy: Subtrees that do not contain value one have answer one. Starting at the node carrying one, walk toward the root and add newly encountered descendants to a shared seen-value set.
